comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Quests in a big chain like this one, especially those that give equipment rewards, usually are not repeatable unless you can lose their discovery card (use it in an official Academy Debate and lose, hoping that card will be lost, or have it come up during Treasure Hunt clue synthesis, and use it in hopes of it being lost there as well).

Now assuming you meet that lost card criteria, or if you have somebody who hasn't done the quest pull it for you, the equipment reward still may never drop for you again; alternatively, it could drop again, but at an extremely low percentage rate, meaning it would take multiple tries.
